description: Fetch a audio `downloads[n].url` from a completed audio project and return it as inline MCP audio content for compatible clients. Pass the exact full signed URL from `downloads[n].url` without trimming query parameters; `expires_at` is separate metadata, not part of the URL. Inline media is capped at 8 MiB; use the signed URL directly for larger downloads.
name: fetch_audio_download
title: Fetch Audio Download
